verdict.rationale: Foreloop collects in-page user feedback, filters spam, and routes submissions to projects or an organization Feedback list, where an agent drafts intentions. Nothing in the evidence shows customer context, such as submitter identity, account, segment, or revenue, being attached to or shown alongside feedback for prioritization. The 'product context' it advertises refers to pull-request review against product understanding, not customer data.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access customer context alongside feedback so I prioritize what really matters
